items.title: To My Son

items.titleIt: A Mio Figlio” (classici)
items.excerpt:
Those flaxen locks, those eyes of blue
Bright as thy mother's in their hue;
Those rosy lips, whose dimples play
And smile to steal the heart away,
Recall a scene of former joy,
And touch thy father's heart, my Boy!
And thou canst lisp a father's name--
Ah, William, were thine own the same,--
No self-reproach--but, let me cease--
My care for thee shall purchase peace;

items.title: There’s Something Weird Inside Mars
items.summary: Un team scientifico ha studiato la superficie marziana, rilevando una differenza significativa tra il polo nord e quello sud. La regione meridionale presenta montagne tre volte più alte dell'Everest, mentre quella settentrionale è caratterizzata da pianure basse e piane. Questa divisione geografica, chiamata "Mars Dichotomy", è stata individuata attraverso l’analisi di piccoli spostamenti satellitari.
items.titleIt: C'è Qualcosa di Strano Dentro Marte
items.excerpt: There’s something weird inside Mars… If you took a slice of the surface you’d see that the north is all low flatlands, but the south is super bumpy with mountains three times taller than Mount Everest… This weird divided geography is called the “Mars Dichotomy” and to find out why, scientists tracked TINY shifts in orbiting satellites' paths over many years…
